semantic_fixtures.covers: Complete actual card; current power threshold, all-player scope, stolen permanent ownership on return, counters cleared by zone changes, and simultaneous cohort return
The ETB instruction does nothing when this source incarnation leaves before resolution
Resolution-time power is evaluated in both directions; a qualifying hexproof creature is included because the effect does not target; a creature entering after resolution is not included
A stale ETB source generation cannot act on a later incarnation
Animated source is first in the exile cohort and returns together with another qualifying nontoken creature; re-entry triggers once and an exiled token is not recreated
Source owner's multiplayer departure removes their own objects, returns surviving owners' exiled cards before publication, and does not stage an unrelated observer trigger from the removed source
A returning Aura's owner choice remains pending during source-owner departure without premature priority publication
